title: Identifying potential neuroprotective polyphenols targeting endoplasmic reticulum stress through an in silico approach.
authors: Singh, Pooja; Kanhed, Ashish; Khatik, Gopal Lal; Datusalia, Ashok Kumar
one_liner_zh: 该文通过分子对接和MD筛选靶向内质网应激蛋白（pPERK/EIF2/ATF4）的神经保护多酚，对象为小分子-蛋白互作，非蛋白质-DNA体系，且无AI/物理模拟方法创新，与本课题无关。
abstract: The endoplasmic reticulum (ER) is essential in many cellular processes, including protein processing, lipid metabolism, and calcium storage. Dysregulation of ER function has been linked with neurodegenerative diseases such as Alzheimer's disease, Parkinson's disease, etc. The primary pathological alteration explicated in the diseases is the accumulation of misfolded proteins in the neuronal cells. ER stress-associated activation of PERK-mediated pro-apoptotic cell death leads to neurodegeneration. In this study, we have primarily screened the potential polyphenols evidenced for neuroprotective activity. The 24 polyphenols were selected to explore their binding affinity towards various proteins of ER cascade such as pPERK (phospho-PERK), EIF2 (Eukaryotic Initiation Factor 2), and ATF4 (Activating Transcription Factor 4). On the basis of binding affinity, four phytopolyphenols were further selected for in-silico ADMET and molecular dynamic simulation. Among them curcumin found to be the most promising and serve as a potential hit against all three targets of ER cascade. The selected proteins' active site has demonstrated high stability of curcumin binding according to molecular dynamics findings. Though curcumin exhibited a significant hit in interaction with targets but needs to be further improved in drug-ability criteria. Thus, seventy derivatives of curcumin scaffold (from the published literature) were also screened with improve in druggability criteria, which showed good interaction with unfolded protein response related targets. The new scaffolds serve considerable potential to be developed as novel polyphenolic lead for neurodegenerative disorders.Communicated by Ramaswamy H. Sarma.
abstract_zh: 内质网（endoplasmic reticulum, ER）在多种细胞过程中至关重要，包括蛋白质加工、脂质代谢和钙储存。ER功能失调与神经退行性疾病如阿尔茨海默病、帕金森病等相关联。这些疾病中阐明的主要病理改变是神经元细胞中错误折叠蛋白质的积累。ER应激相关的PERK介导的促凋亡细胞死亡激活导致神经退行性变。在本研究中，我们初步筛选了具有神经保护活性的潜在多酚类化合物。选取24种多酚，探讨它们与ER级联反应中多种蛋白质（如pPERK（磷酸化PERK）、EIF2（真核起始因子2）和ATF4（激活转录因子4））的结合亲和力。基于结合亲和力，进一步选择了四种植物多酚进行计算机模拟ADMET和分子动力学模拟。其中，姜黄素被发现是最有前景的，并对ER级联的所有三个靶点均表现出潜在的命中作用。根据分子动力学结果，所选蛋白质的活性位点展示了姜黄素结合的高稳定性。尽管姜黄素在与靶点的相互作用中表现出显著的命中效果，但其药物可用性标准仍需进一步改进。因此，还筛选了七十种姜黄素骨架衍生物（来自已发表文献），这些衍生物在药物可用性标准上有所改善，并与未折叠蛋白反应相关靶点表现出良好相互作用。新骨架具有相当大的潜力，可开发为针对神经退行性疾病的新型多酚类先导化合物。由Ramaswamy H. Sarma通讯。
